programmes.d: It's a big day today - Blue's going to the doctor for her annual checkup! We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do after her checkup.

Today we're counting things throughout the house and labeling them with big numbers. We learn that Joe's favorite number is one. But what's Blue's favorite? We play Blue's Clues to figure out which number is Blue's favorite!

Where is Baby Bird? Over or under Joe's head? On or off the branch? Using relational concepts, we help Joe find Baby Bird. Blue wants to find something too, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what.

Wow, you're over pretty late today. Joe's stuffed duck Boris is ready for his favorite part of bedtime, getting tucked in, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue's favorite part of bedtime is.

What's going to happen next? Some big event seems to be brewing on the patio, but we're not sure what. Blue has an idea, though, so we play Blue's Clues to predict what's going to happen on the patio.

Everybody is dressing up today! Blue is being a giraffe, and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants us to be! Joe tries different costumes throughout the day - does he want to be an explorer, robot, or a duck?

We're making a giant story on the wall with pictures! It's about some rabbits who go on a trip to visit their grandma. But what will the rabbits do once they get to her house? Blue knows! We play Blue's Clues to figure it out!

Magenta is going on a trip and asked us to take care of her house while she's away! Magenta leaves us a message so we'll know what to do. Blue wants to write a message, too and we play Blue's Clues to figure out what to say.

Joe and Blue are being writers today! We're making labels for things in our house - like-hat, door, and Sidetable Drawer. Using our finger, we help Joe write letters. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to write.

Blue's Clues is a puppy with a clue - three actually - and preschoolers will play along with this original play-to-learn show. Through problem-solving and skill-building games, preschoolers help Steve or Joe find the answer.

For Clam Day, the Bubble Guppies decide to throw a party for Clam and invite his cousin Sam. But before they can send Sam an invitation, they need to learn all about how the mail works.

The Bubble Guppies explore different kinds of ball games as they get ready for their big game of Fishketball! Join Team Guppies to help them practice bouncing, throwing, catching and playing together as a team.
It’s going to be the best doghouse EVER! But before Bubble Puppy can move into his new doggy digs, the Bubble Guppies have to build it. Help them build it while discovering all about construction.

At the Bubble Guppies' restaurant, the group is waiting tables, cooking food,and preparing to serve their most difficult customer yet. But is there anything on the menu that can get the Grumpfish grinning?
Are you ready to rock? The Bubble Guppies are taking the stage with their guitars, drums and keyboards. Get ready to crank it up to 10 and learn about everything rock and roll.
When Oona’s friend Avi breaks a bone in his tail, he needs to visit the doctor. The Bubble Guppies aren’t too worried – after they learn that it’s a doctor’s job to make everyone feel better.
The Bubble Guppies are going on a camping trip! Grab your flashlights and gather around the campfire to make s'mores and hear about the spooky legend of Pinkfoot!
Gil wants to adopt a puppy! But before he can bring the puppy home, the Bubble Guppies must learn how to take care of pets.
Rawrrrrrr! While the Bubble Guppies are digging for dinosaur bones, they learn all about different types of dinosaurs.
To celebrate Shrimptennial, the Bubble Guppies visit Big Bubble City! Join them in discovering the hustle and bustle of the big city and the Big Bubble Building!
With an "oink, oink" here and a "moo, moo" there, the Bubble Guppies learn all about farm animals … and discover that a lot of their favorite foods come from a farm too!
The play's the thing when the Bubble Guppies go to see a production of "The Three Little Pigs." But when one of the actors can't perform, it's up to Deema to put on the costume and take the stage.
The Spring Chicken is about to announce the arrival of spring, but first, she needs a beautiful flower. Help the Bubble Guppies figure out how to plant and care for a flower.
Glide through the aisles of the supermarket with the Bubble Guppies as they shop for fruits, vegetables and the last box of Bubble Bites for Bubble Puppy!
Boo! The Bubble Guppies are invited to a costume party at a haunted house! They dress up as witches, vampires, werewolves, zombies and mummies, but who’s that in the spooky ghost costume?
Green means GO! The Bubble Guppies are learning about colors while car racing! Help them mix colors, make new shades, and speed across the finish line!
Learn about different musical instruments as you join the Bubble Guppies' marching band, and help Nonny figure out how to lead the band when there's a duck in the way!
Blast off with the Bubble Guppies – it’s time to learn all about the solar system! Help them begin to learn about outer space in this far-out episode.
Pack a suitcase and hurry to the airport! Help the Bubble Guppies fly an airplane through the sky and over the clouds - just be sure to keep an eye out for airplane pirates!

A friendly squirrel gives Nonny an acorn that will someday grow into a tree! Join the Bubble Guppies in learning all about trees -the animals that live in them, the fruit that grows on them, and how they can help them.
Ahoy, mateys! Set sail on a pirate adventure with Gil, Molly and their Guppy friends as they help a friendly pirate use a treasure map to find where X marks the spot!
Everyone is getting ready for the holidays everyone except Mr. Grumpfish. The Guppies do their festive best to show a grumpy neighbor the joy of the holiday season.
Meet Monty the loneliest (and only-est) rhinoceros in the zoo. He needs a friend, and Gil and the Bubble Guppies are determined to help while learning all about habitats at the zoo!
When a Witch turns Bubble Puppy into a frog, Molly and Gil team up with famous fairytale friends to undo her mean green spell and help everyone in the Enchanted Forest live happily ever after!

When Gil and Bubble Puppy get stuck in a tree, a heroic team of firefighters comes to the rescue! But what happens when the firefighters get stuck in a tree?
Yee-haw! Molly wants to be a cowgirl like Dusty, the riden-est, ropin-est cowgirl in the parade! But when Dustys calf gets into trouble, Molly has to use everything shes learned to save the day.

There are lots of different kinds of trucks, but only one that can turn into a giant robot - Humunga-Truck! The Bubble Guppies learn all about different kinds of trucks on their way to the big Truck Show!
Deema has a loose tooth, and when it falls out, shes going to get a visit from the Tooth Fairy! Until then, the Bubble Guppies have lots to discover about keeping a healthy smile.
